recommendation: Keep the no-change audit. Do not downgrade Transport or re-add it to active core for this R5 FMM-1 issue; any future Transport cleanup belongs to the later FHIR-37524/additional-resources path.
issue_request: FHIR-38665 was Published/Persuasive for R5 by OO and requested raising DeviceRequest and Transport to FMM 1 because their resource proposals had been approved.
initial_application: The Jira-tagged commit e0157e2607913e36abf041d93616354a93f2785e changed source/fhir.ini devicerequest and transport from FMM 0 to FMM 1. DeviceRequest's per-resource StructureDefinition FMM was later aligned by FHIR-38898 in commit 113845b941e4a259175bd20710e78da8c485fb14.
additional_context: Current fhir.ini lists DeviceRequest as an active resource and FMM 1. Current DeviceRequest StructureDefinition also has FMM 1. Transport retained metadata is FMM 2 after FHIR-37524/commit 28b423e10063e8a3c748d859f1d9a02e4d1571d5, and commit 3b38b80cf23f9cbb306fab8fcedb293315478c32 removed Transport from the active fhir.ini [resources] list as part of later Additional Resources/incubator work.
reconciliation: No source edit was made. The current active DeviceRequest source satisfies the request, and the remaining Transport source metadata exceeds the requested FMM while Transport is not an active core resource in the current build configuration.

related_jiras.note: Published/Persuasive follow-up that explicitly changed DeviceRequest StructureDefinition FMM to 1 after FHIR-38665's fhir.ini-only application.
Applied Transport follow-up that assessed Transport to FMM 2 and stated it would move to Additional Resources.
